nutrition.basis: Approximate calculation from drained recipe weights and generic USDA FDC ingredient references; tortilla size and product labels (especially sodium) vary. Rounded per portion; not a laboratory analysis.
nutrition.method: Scale FoodData Central per-100-g reference nutrient values by measured edible ingredient weights, sum recipe totals, divide by 4 portions; lime juice treated approximately as 1 g/mL.

nutrition.basis: Approximate calculation from drained recipe weights and generic USDA FDC ingredient references; tortilla size and product labels (especially sodium) vary. Rounded per portion; not a laboratory analysis.
nutrition.method: Scale FoodData Central per-100-g reference nutrient values by measured edible ingredient weights, sum recipe totals, divide by 4 portions; lime juice treated approximately as 1 g/mL.
